requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Printer for SMBs
requirements.Description: Develop HP's first business ink tank printer targeted at unmanaged to lightly managed micro/small businesses (SMBs) with 5-250 employees, 6-15 printers, and AMPV of 500 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a gap in HP's portfolio for CISS PLE Hi segment and meets the needs of SMBs lacking dedicated IT support.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: A new business ink tank printer is developed and launched, specifically marketed and positioned for SMBs as described.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity features, including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan, and provide best-in-class scan workflow and manageability solutions.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates HP's offering and addresses customer needs for easier business management and efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Development of AI software and integration with printer firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features (Perfect Print/Scan) and manageability solutions are available at launch, validated by user testing and documentation.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
requirements.Description: Design the printer to deliver HP's lowest business TCO, minimizing intervention and maintenance for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top priority for SMBs and a key differentiator in a competitive market.
requirements.Dependencies: Printer hardware design, ink tank efficiency, consumables pricing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Documented TCO analysis showing Magellan has the lowest business TCO among HP's SMB printers.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer is manufactured with at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitor benchmarks.
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key customer value and competitive differentiator (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Dependencies: Sourcing of recycled materials, manufacturing processes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and independent verification confirm 60% or greater RCP in product.

requirements.Title: Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Include a user-replaceable maintenance box to reduce service calls and downtime for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses new customer segment needs and supports ease of maintenance for non-IT users.
requirements.Dependencies: Printer design, supply chain for maintenance boxes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is user-replaceable, with supporting documentation and positive user feedback from pilot testing.

requirements.Title: Consolidated SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for SMBs to manage their printers, targeting unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Simplifies device management for non-IT decision makers and enhances customer experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal software development, integration with device telemetry.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is available at launch, supports management of multiple devices, and receives positive usability testing results.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Offer warranty coverage of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever is first), and enable customer-replaceable parts (PHA) with MINK service center support if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for SMBs, aligns with market expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Service infrastructure, part supply chain, documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are clearly communicated, and customer-replaceable parts are supported in product documentation and service training.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Utilize keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure user safety and product reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents user error and potential product damage, supporting quality and customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink bottle and printer hardware design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottles are uniquely keyed and only compatible with intended printer models; verified by testing.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance Improvements
requirements.Description: For PDL SKUs, deliver print speeds of at least 25 ppm (pages per minute) for black and 20 ppm for color, with PDL/PS support and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures competitive performance and meets regulatory/environmental standards for business users.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware development, certification process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKUs achieve specified print speeds and obtain Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU Advanced Solutions Support
requirements.Description: Non-PDL SKUs must support SMB2.0 Solutions, Advanced View SMB portal, and PaaS (Platform as a Service) features.
requirements.Rationale: Extends manageability and solutions offering to a broader product range, increasing value for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKUs are compatible with SMB2.0 Solutions and portal, and support PaaS features at launch.

requirements.Title: AI Solutions for Print, Scan, Support
requirements.Description: Develop and integrate AI-powered solutions for print, scan, and support workflows to enhance productivity and user experience.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages emerging technology to deliver superior user experiences and business outcomes.
requirements.Dependencies: AI software development, integration with device and portal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-powered print, scan, and support features are available at launch and validated through user testing.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing capabilities through the HP App, supporting key SMB use cases.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses the growing trend of mobile device usage in SMBs and enhances convenience.
requirements.Dependencies: HP App integration, printer firmware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing is fully functional via HP App and verified by interoperability testing.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to collect device usage and health data for proactive support and analytics.
requirements.Rationale: Enables predictive maintenance, enhances serviceability, and supports ongoing product improvement.
requirements.Stakeholders: R&D Telemetry, Quality, Supplies Quality, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Device firmware, portal integration, data privacy compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is collected securely, accessible via portal, and used for analytics; compliant with data regulations.

requirements.Title: Maintenance-Free or Less Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Design the printer to require minimal maintenance, with fewer parts to replace over its lifetime (subject to ongoing investigation).
requirements.Rationale: Reduces total cost of ownership and appeals to SMBs without dedicated IT support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Documented reduction in maintenance frequency and parts replacement compared to prior models; validated by pilot testing.
